# Publish list for James Nerf Squad: the paths that go on the public site.
# Everything here is public. Never add a secret or non-public file.
# The game is a static page: index.html loads css/style.css and the js/ files,
# css/style.css loads the fonts, and js/main.js fetches VERSION at run time.
# Sound is generated in code (Web Audio), so there are no audio files.
/index.html
/VERSION
/css/
/js/
/fonts/

# One require line per runtime file, so the live check fails if any is lost.
require /index.html
require /VERSION
require /css/style.css
require /js/announcer.js
require /js/boss.js
require /js/constants.js
require /js/enemy.js
require /js/game.js
require /js/hud.js
require /js/icons.js
require /js/input.js
require /js/main.js
require /js/music.js
require /js/particles.js
require /js/player.js
require /js/screens.js
require /js/sound.js
require /js/speech.js
require /js/touch.js
require /js/utils.js
require /fonts/PressStart2P-cyrillic-ext.woff2
require /fonts/PressStart2P-cyrillic.woff2
require /fonts/PressStart2P-greek.woff2
require /fonts/PressStart2P-latin-ext.woff2
require /fonts/PressStart2P-latin.woff2
